tenderAddress.blockNumber: Directorate of Urban Land Transport, BMTC TTMC, B Block, Kengal Hanumanthaiah Road, Shanti Nagar

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder should be a firm/Company registered in India under the Companies Act 2013 or under LLP Act 2008 or Societies Registration Act, 1860 and operational at least for the last 5 years.
The average annual financial turnover of the Bidder as per the audited financial statement of last 5 years, ending 31st March 2026, should be at least Rs. 300 Lakhs.
Bidder should have a positive net worth in past 5 years, ending 31st March 2026.
Bidder should not be blacklisted/banned by any government/semi-government authority in India for the supply of materials/carrying out operations and maintenance work/application development.
The bidder should have an office in Karnataka.
Consultant should be registered with Sales Tax/ Income Tax Department of Government of India.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in preparation of detailed designs of integrated urban roads of at least 10 km stretch including travel lanes, footpaths and a minimum of 3-5 underground utilities. Completion certificates of projects with DPR / GFCS to be submitted. Refer to tender document for breakup.
Experience in working on integrated roads in Karnataka.
Design methodology. Approach for BRTS corridor redesign and improvement, junction improvement, traffic management, road safety, pedestrian and NMT facilities.
Understanding of existing BRTS operations, corridor and junction conditions, traffic movement, ROW constraints, pedestrian/NMT movement and key challenges.
Relevant codes, guidelines and best practices for BRTS corridor, junction, traffic, pedestrian and NMT design.
Team composition. Please refer to the tender documents for details.
